copy.headline: UT Southwestern a step closer to opening
copy.caption:
Big news for Fort Worth 🏗️

UT Southwestern a step closer to opening of Radiation Oncology center

UT Southwestern placed the final beam on its $177 million radiation oncology center in the Fort Worth Medical District on Nov. 16, moving a step closer to the anticipated 2028 opening. The center will offer MRI-guided radiation…

📍 Fort Worth, TX

story.title: UT Southwestern a step closer to opening of Radiation Oncology center
story.summary: UT Southwestern placed the final beam on its $177 million radiation oncology center in the Fort Worth Medical District on Nov. 16, moving a step closer to the anticipated 2028 opening. The center will offer MRI-guided radiation treatments, a first for Fort Worth.
